description:
The Sanitas Pistil XC is handcrafted using hand-selected, size-specific, cold-worked 3/2.5 titanium tubing. Each frame is designed and built one by one in our Durango, Colorado, facility to provide a ride that’s specifically catered to the customer’s riding style and needs in mind.

Designed around hand-picked oversized cold-worked and stress-relieved titanium tubing, a hydroformed downtube, and an independent carbon rear triangle. Now utilizing Allied’s BC40 carbon rear triangle and linkage for an even higher level of performance! The Pistil XC delivers fast and nimble trail handling through its progressive geometry, 120mm of dual suspension travel, and high-end materials that meet the needs of today’s modern XC rider. We manufacture the titanium front triangle by hand, which is meticulously mated with a custom-designed independent carbon rear triangle using a dual pivot design and lightweight stock rear suspension. This translates into the bike having efficient engagement to the rear wheel when climbing, all the while feeling supple, stable, and secure through the descents. The Pistil XC’s design has been optimized to provide ample tire clearance of 29 x 2.4”, so you get that smooth ride over all types of terrain. With the ability to hand-select the components of your choosing for your Pistil XC frame, you can build a lightweight race machine, high-performance trail-ready bike, or anything in between.

Each frame is designed and built one by one in our Durango, Colorado, facility to provide a ride that’s specifically catered to the customer’s riding style and needs in mind.

The customization does not stop with your frame geometry or finish! Drivetrain and components are just as personal as your riding style! With the ability to hand-select the components of your choice, you have 100% say in building out the bike of your dreams. Complete bike builds are quoted upon request and individualized for each rider.
